text:
Alex: heads-up, token/sec on the ctb fleet dropped ~20% after the kernel-routing merge (PR #4127) this morning :grimacing:
Maria: seeing the same in staging and one canary, good catch. any obvious diffs in scheduler metrics?
Kevin: queueing latency up, draining slower, but batch sizes actually increased slightly — odd.
Zach: I ran a quick flamegraph on a slow worker, looks like we flip kernels mid-batch more often now. snippet:
```
# perf script -> flamegraph
kernel_select() + 22.1%  <-- hot
pack_batches()  + 15.4%
kv_cache_lookup  + 10.2%
memcopy_fallback +  8.6%
```
Maria: mid-batch kernel hops would invalidate prefetch assumptions and force memcopy paths, explains memcopy bump.
Priya: I started a bisect across the last 15 merges, forcing kernel_preference off reverts throughput back to baseline on one host.
Alex: nice, which commit?
Priya: suspect range narrows to 2026-02-28..2026-03-03, candidate PRs that touch kernel probing + coalescer.
Kevin: CI perf job also flagged a regression in `ctb_throughput_test` on linux-x86-rt image, stack trace similar. CI-Bot: run 2026-03-14T09:12 failed (regression +18% wall time).
SRE-Bot: rolling hold applied to the canary pool, alert created INC-2026-118.
Zach: quick patch idea — disable kernel hop probe inside active batches, keep probe only during idle windows. micro-benchmarks show no perf hit on cold-path.
Maria: can we test that as a runtime flag? would be safe for canary rollback.
Priya: deploying a canary build with `--ctb-disable-midbatch-probe=true` to one node now.
Alex: ping when metrics land, I'll watch token/sec and memcopy latency.
(5m later)
Priya: canary reports token/sec +16% vs bad master, memcopy tail trimmed.
Maria: looks good, no impact on correctness in our smoke tests.
Kevin: let's open a small revert PR or feature-flag the probe as default-off until we instrument probe cost better.
Alex: agree. create PR, link the CI perf job and the bisect notes. add release note: "disable mid-batch kernel probing (regression mitigation)".
Priya: PR up: https://git.internal/r/PR-4268 (flag + revert candidate).
Zach: also adding a perf test that runs sequences of tiny prompts to catch this in CI.
Maria: adding perf regression alert to the rollout checklist.
Alex: thanks all. follow-up: schedule a deeper perf session tomorrow to understand long-term probe strategy and KV cache interactions. :thumbsup:
CI-Bot: PR-4268 job matrix started, will notify on perf-green
SRE-Bot: canary hold lifted after metrics stabilized. (reaction: :tada:)
